metric_definitions.address_specificity: stored_market_sibling_proposals.safe_stored_street; conservative lexical suitability, not geocoding or independent truth
metric_definitions.clock_intervals: happings_detail_layout._intervals on retained orario_testo; recognizes explicit HH:MM pair, not source truth or complete daily schedule
metric_definitions.hours_precision_limitation: There is no single source-independent exact-hours audit in the repo. Nonempty hours and recognizable interval counts must not be called verified exact hours.
metric_definitions.source_freshness: source_freshness.source_date_evidence; unknown legacy import timestamps excluded; 540-day bound is existing forecast policy
metric_definitions.field_evidence: field_evidence.audit; recent read <=45days, address source <=365days, hours/recurrence source <=180days
metric_definitions.future_dates: as_day(date)>=as_of, grouped by saved date_quality; predicted, reported and confirmed remain distinct
metric_definitions.forecast_holds: recurrence_refresh.refresh_record reason only; computed candidate discarded, no changes applied
metric_definitions.reader_support: publisher_refresh.catalog_resources configured layout capability; not a new source read
metric_definitions.review_findings: source-format-review-ledger and existing 2026-10-20 sample reports; sample yield is not source-wide yield

method_caveats: Stored source URL is attribution, not proof that each current field has recently been checked.
No valid field receipt in exported rows does not erase independently reviewed PDF/dataset evidence elsewhere; it means that field-bound evidence is not yet exported.
audit_dataset uses a smaller vague-address list (5889 empty/vague); publisher_quality_matrix uses its established broader VAGUE_ADDRESSES list (5924 empty/vague). Do not mix definitions.
37 saved hour values literally say NA; presence-only metrics count these as filled, so hours-present is an upper bound on usable hours.
The conservative street rule is a lexical import-safety rule. A descriptive venue failing it is not necessarily an incorrect address.
Source sample recovery counts describe only sampled documents, not a yield estimate for all catalog rows.
Reader support is configured capability. This audit performs no network requests; not_observed is not proof a source is unavailable.
Forecast reason counts are obtained in memory and discarded; current public dates were not modified.
